basis: Audited fiscal-year endowment amounts reported by each institution; accounting scope and presentation differ by school.
explanation: Both values are from audited statements for June 30, 2025, but the statements use different scopes. DePauw reports total endowment net assets including pledges receivable and perpetual trusts; Wabash reports pooled endowment net assets. These are not identical market-value bases and are not cash available for general spending.

depauw.source_note: Note 12, printed pp. 20–21 (PDF pp. 22–23): total endowment net assets at June 30, 2025, including $38,817,699 of pledges receivable and $13,010,125 of perpetual trusts

wabash.source_note: Note 11, printed pp. 23–24 (PDF pp. 25–26): pooled endowment net assets at June 30, 2025
